scope: Verificar WebGL chart (Lightweight Charts) no frontend em http://127.0.0.1:8002

passing_checks.candlestick_renders: Candlestick series renders with 7 canvases in main pane
passing_checks.volume_renders: Volume histogram renders as recessive bars
passing_checks.legend_exists: Legend with all 5 overlay indicators (SMA20, SMA50, EMA20, BB, VWAP)
passing_checks.tooltip_exists: Tooltip div exists (z-index:100, display:none, blur backdrop)
passing_checks.dark_theme: Stage background rgb(17,24,32) = #111820, CSS variables set

CRITICAL_indicator_format.description: Backend returns indicators as [{time,value},...] but buildLineData calls isFinite(arr[i]) which returns FALSE for objects. All indicator lines silently fail to render (SMA20, SMA50, EMA20, BB, RSI, VWAP). Only OHLCV candles and volume appear.
CRITICAL_indicator_format.fix: Pass backend {time,value} objects directly to Lightweight Charts series.setData()

CRITICAL_macd_format.description: Backend returns macd/macd_histogram/macd_signal as separate [{time,value}] arrays. chart.js expects ind.macd = {histogram:[], line:[], signal:[]}. MACD sub-pane contains zero data points.
CRITICAL_macd_format.evidence: ind.macd is Array, not Object. macd.histogram = undefined. All series receive empty arrays.
CRITICAL_macd_format.fix: Read macd_histogram as histogram, macd as line, macd_signal as signal, extracting .value from each

HIGH_vwap_missing.description: Backend response has no 'vwap' key. chart.js calls vwapSeries.setData() with undefined. Legend shows VWAP but no line appears.
HIGH_vwap_missing.evidence: All 7 indicator keys in response: sma20, sma50, ema20, rsi, macd, macd_histogram, macd_signal, bb_upper, bb_middle, bb_lower. No vwap.
HIGH_vwap_missing.fix: Add VWAP computation to backend (or remove from legend)

HIGH_auth_devmode_bug.description: auth.js checks /health for dev-mode detection. /health is public in production too. Result: login skipped but /api/chart-data/ returns 401.
HIGH_auth_devmode_bug.evidence: .env.local has SUPEREZIO_JWT_SECRET set. /health returns 200 always. Chart data API returns 401.
HIGH_auth_devmode_bug.fix: Check if token exists / JWT secret is configured, not just /health response

HIGH_datahub_timeout.description: Backend chart-data endpoint calls Twelve Data API which hangs (>30s). Even with valid JWT, chart data never loads to frontend.
HIGH_datahub_timeout.evidence: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' returns 0 bytes after 30s. Server log shows 'twelve_data succeeded' but response never completes.
HIGH_datahub_timeout.fix: Add timeout/circuit-breaker to DataHub calls or mock data for dev

MEDIUM_register_tokens.description: POST /auth/register returns UserResponse (profile only). Frontend expects access_token + refresh_token in response.
MEDIUM_register_tokens.evidence: auth.py register route returns UserResponse model. auth.js register() calls saveTokens(data.access_token, data.refresh_token) which get undefined.
MEDIUM_register_tokens.fix: Register endpoint should return TokenResponse (with tokens) after creating user

MEDIUM_canvas2d_format.description: Old Canvas 2D renderers also expect flat arrays (ind.sma_20 with underscore). Backend has ind.sma20 (no underscore) as [{time,value}] objects.
MEDIUM_canvas2d_format.evidence: render-chart.js: drawSeries(ind.sma_20, BLUE). Backend: sma20 as [{time,value}] objects.
MEDIUM_canvas2d_format.fix: Chart.js already supersedes this path, but if fallback is needed, fix the key names and value format

risks: Users see empty indicator lines with no error feedback (silent failure via catch(e){/*ignore*/})
Chart shows only candles and volume - all technical analysis indicators missing
Frontend dev-mode detection logs user in but 401s on every API call
next_steps: Fix buildLineData() to pass {time,value} objects directly to LW setData()
Fix buildMACD() to read macd_histogram/macd/macd_signal correctly
Add timeout to DataHub candle fetch
